again...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mikko Saari wrote:
>
> Is this legal:
>
> Beast rushes someon with his ability, then another vampire picks the fight
> with Mask. Beast rushes again, and another vamp picks it. Beast rushes
> again...
>
> Is that against NRA?

It isn't a violation of NRA - NRA only "kicks in" on the acting minion
when the action resolves. If the action is masked, only the final acting
minion becomes incapable of performing the action again in the current
turn.

However, it is illegal to Mask a special ability action, like Beast's
built-in rush, since no other minion is capable of initiating that
action for themselves.

--

Messages.Author: Richard Zopf
Messages.Body:
Fish Flowers wrote in message ...

>Hmm... Wynn, or Ebanezer Roush, or Roxanne Mask Beast's built-in rush?
>(Assuming, for Ebanezer and Roxanne, that the target is 3-cap or less.)
>
>

Sadly, No. Special abilities are unique to the vamp who has the card
text... No one can assume another's unique rush. Think if it as if the
specials were the titles to cards only that particular vamp could play, ie:
Action: Beast's Rush Ability
Action: Ebanezer's Rush Ability
Action: Roxanne's Rush Ability
Action: Wynn's Rush Ability
